name: Disco-X
intro: DiscoX是一个针对专家领域语篇级翻译的新基准，旨在解决现有评估方法主要关注片段级准确性和流畅性的不足。它包含200篇来自7个领域的专业文本，平均长度超过1700个词元。同时，该基准还开发了Metric-S，一个无参考的自动评估系统，用于评估翻译的准确性、流畅性和适当性。实验表明，即使是最先进的LLM在这些任务上的表现仍落后于人类专家，验证了DiscoX的难度。
build_method: 领域专家策展, 语言专家同行评审, 双模型难度过滤, 专家评分点标注
eval_feature: 无参考评估, 多智能体裁判, 分层错误去重, 严重度加权
scale: 665个候选 → 200个任务, 英译中100 + 中译英100, 7个领域, 平均1712.17词元
build_method_en: Domain-expert curation, linguistic peer review, two-model difficulty filtering, expert rubric annotation
eval_feature_en: Reference-free evaluation, multi-agent judges, hierarchical error deduplication, severity weighting
intro_en: DiscoX is a new benchmark for expert-domain discourse-level translation, designed to address the limitations of existing evaluations that mainly focus on segment-level accuracy and fluency. It includes 200 professional texts from 7 domains, with an average length of over 1700 tokens. The benchmark also introduces Metric-S, a reference-free automatic evaluation system for assessing translation accuracy, fluency, and appropriateness. Experiments show that even state-of-the-art LLMs still lag behind human experts on these tasks, confirming the difficulty of DiscoX.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.10984 Sections 2.1-2.2 and 3.1-3.4. The diagram records 133 curators (115 domain experts and 18 linguistic specialists), 1,330 person-hours, authentic texts above the 1,500-character/word threshold, expert rubrics averaging 9.38 per task, the 665-item pool, linguistic peer review, the requirement that both SOTA models fail at least eight rubrics, final expert selection of 200 bilingual tasks, instruction-following zero gate, separate accuracy/fluency/appropriateness judges, hierarchical root-cause deduplication, 60/20/20 component maxima, and 2/5/10/50 severity deductions.
